title: Design Services for LT Ross Building Structure Repair
short_description: Design services for structural repair and refurbishment of the LT Ross Building.
project_scope: Professional design services for repair of the LT Ross Building structure. The notice indicates a building rehabilitation and refurbishment project involving structural repair, with related civil, mechanical, electrical, and interior design/space planning disciplines. No gross floor area, structural system, or other technical dimensions are stated.
services: Professional engineering and architectural consulting services for building structure repair, including structural engineering, civil engineering, rehabilitation and refurbishment design, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and interior design/space planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Building rehabilitation project with a clear structural engineering component.
- Potentially relevant due to structural repair of an existing building.
- However, the notice provides no information on structural complexity, span, size, or architectural ambition.
- Multi-discipline building repair appears more conventional than sbp's core focus on bridges, long-span roofs, and special structures.
- Still worth limited attention because it is a design assignment, not only construction or PM.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the source. Available information for a future estimate: building structure repair and refurbishment project for the LT Ross Building in Knoxville, involving structural, civil, MEP, and interior-related design services; no area, damage extent, or intervention scope is provided, so no realistic cost estimate can be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is stated in the source. The notice only confirms a professional design services procurement for a multi-disciplinary building repair project; without construction cost, service phases, or fee basis, no realistic fee estimate is possible.
references_qualifications: Professional engineering and architectural consulting firm or team of firms with extensive experience in building structure repair. Disciplines requested include structural engineering, civil engineering, rehabilitation and refurbishment, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, and interior design/space planning.
